atomic_prompt_rules: Extract one independently remediable, explicitly observed weakness per record. If one audit observation reports several distinct failures, create separate records with specific evidence for each; do not collapse independent failures into a compound description. Conversely, do not split a single underlying deficiency into synonyms, consequences, or repeated wording. Treat a list of actions needed to fix one lifecycle control as one deficiency unless distinct independently testable control gaps are explicitly stated. Do not infer observations solely from recommendations, general standards, or agency responses. For findings in tables use the actual printed table identifier as observation_id. For numbered narrative findings use the actual paragraph identifier. Never invent or recycle a source identifier. The evidence quote must occur within the identified paragraph or table, not merely elsewhere on the PDF page.
